vision.visionText: Achieving leadership in engineering and vocational education and training locally and regionally, while providing training support for company employees.
vision.missionText: Preparing and qualifying generations of outstanding professional cadres to meet the company's and labor market's requirements through an ideal training environment in accordance with quality standards.
vision.strategy1: Preparing qualified cadres in an innovative and supportive environment with technical excellence, leadership skills, and practical skills.
vision.strategy2: Elevating the institute's leading role in technical education and development to contribute to the knowledge economy through effective community partnerships.
vision.strategy3: Strengthening the institute's role by offering locally and internationally accredited programs, services, and studies that respond to labor market changes.
vision.strategy4: Ensuring all services are delivered according to global quality and efficiency standards, embedding a culture of innovation in the institutional work environment.
vision.goalsSubtitle: The institute aims to develop staff through:
vision.goal1: Creating cooperation opportunities with relevant bodies such as universities, research institutes, and international organizations.
vision.goal2: Linking the professional path of supervisors and craftsmen to technical training plans.
vision.goal3: Preparing and qualifying second-tier leadership within the company (Future Leaders).

cea.subtitle: برنامج اعداد مهندس مكتب فني (6 months) - Commercial Engineering Apprenticeship Program (CEA)
cea.intro1: A distinctive program based on the concept of pre-employment training. Since the technical office is the backbone of any project, this program aims to prepare technical office engineers by equipping new engineers with the knowledge and skills needed to carry out their duties and responsibilities in a way that contributes to project success, after which they are distributed to technical offices across the company's projects.
cea.intro2: The program is designed to include engineer training, divided into the following phases:
cea.objective1: Required theoretical knowledge (specialized lectures and practical workshops).
cea.objective2: Practical skills (hands-on training at the company's branches, departments, and projects).
cea.stagesTitle: The Program is Divided into Three Phases
cea.stage1Content: Introducing engineers to the company, its regulations, objectives, and vision, then introducing the tasks of the technical office. This phase includes training at the various Gesr El Suez workshops with a focus on both theoretical and practical training.
cea.stage2Content: Covers the tasks of the various technical office departments including tenders, contracts, surveying, measurement, interim payments, claims, procurement planning, warehouse systems, purchasing, and administrative skills. In parallel, trainees receive English language lectures.
cea.stage3Content: Involves engineers visiting departments and branches to apply what they have studied in real work environments across specialized departments, concluding with visits to key projects to experience the technical office's work on-site.
